lines.title: A week's overdraft on the phone

low.label: M-PESA overdraft (Fuliza)
low.detail: one-off 1% access fee plus the published daily fee for the balance band, excise included

best.label: Bank loan, industry average
best.detail: weighted average lending rate across commercial banks, charged for the same days

lines.formula: overdraft = amount × access fee % + daily band fee × days; bank = amount × average lending rate × days ÷ 365; premium = overdraft − bank
lines.note: The bank figure is an average, not a loan anyone can take for a week; a bank loan needs time, a credit check and often security.

lines.title: A month's mobile loan

low.label: Mobile loan, the lowest published charge we track
low.detail: M-Shwari loan: the provider's published charge, over its 30-day term

best.label: Bank loan, industry average
best.detail: weighted average lending rate across commercial banks, charged for the same days

lines.formula: mobile loan = amount × published charge % for its term; bank = amount × average lending rate × days ÷ 365; premium = mobile loan − bank
lines.note: 2 mobile loans held; the lowest charge is used, so the premium is the least a mobile borrower pays over the average.

lines.title: A SACCO loan
lines.missing: SACCO loan rates. We hold SACCO dividends and interest on deposits, not what SACCOs charge borrowers.
lines.wouldNeed: Loan rates published by SACCOs or by SASRA, read from the primary page and dated.

lines.title: A year's savings
lines.example: KES 10,000 for a year, after 15% withholding tax

low.label: Bank savings account, industry average
low.detail: weighted average savings rate across commercial banks, after tax

best.label: 364-day Treasury bill
best.detail: weighted average rate at the latest auction, after tax; the Central Bank's minimum is KES 50,000 face value

lines.formula: earnings = amount × gross yearly rate × (1 − 15% tax); premium = Treasury bill earnings − bank savings earnings

context.label: Money market fund, median published yield
context.detail: middle of the 5 funds whose yield we read, after tax

context.label: Money market fund, highest published yield
context.detail: Zimele Fixed Income Fund (Savings Plan), after tax

lines.note: A saver with less than KES 50,000 cannot buy the bill. Money market funds are shown beside it; we do not hold their minimum deposits.
